notes.title: Patch Notes for Release 20220117.2
notes.content:
[h1]Simple is better![/h1]

We know... you've all been waiting for a new release for some time now.
Finally, we are glad to present the highlights of the latest changes and a glimpse into the next development plans.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Learning the free marketplace reroll talent will have an immediate effect on the current round as well.
[*] Bring simpler, more lightweight and unified look to the arenas.
[/list]


[h2]Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix Rook synergy bug with wrong damage calculation.
[*] Fix Dragon Scale Scrapper talent.
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rebalancing: stronger Knights, nerfed Pawns, opening potential for new formations to try out
[*] Preparations for tournaments hosting
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Release 20201121.1

notes.title: Patch Notes for Release 20201109.1
notes.content:
[h1]The Matchmaking has been improved![/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduce game placement timeouts.
[*] Players will be notified earlier when there is no server available for hosting a game.
[*] During Quick/Ranked Play Matchmaking, the loading screen can be minimized to allow browsing the main menu while waiting.
[/list]

[h2]Changes for Pieces[/h2]
[list]
[*] Banshee: 
[list]
[*] Old: Range - 2.5|3.0|3.5 Cells → [b]New: Range - 2.5 Cells (For all levels)[/b]
[*] Old: Ability Charges - 5 → [b]New: Ability Charges - 7[/b]
[/list]
[*] Griffin: 
[list]
[*] Old: Ability Charges - 10 → [b]New: Ability Charges - 7[/b]
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Master Sound level is now properly persisted upon game restarts.
[*] Phantom Board Master will no longer appear on customizations screen viewport.
[*] Phantom pieces won't be spawned by bots on players' areas.
[*] Fixed FX for various pieces. Projectiles are now more reliable on client's representation.
[*] Fixed Succubus rotation after the ability cast.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Release 20201030.1
notes.content:
[h1]Bots have learned how to play. Now they can stand a fight![/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bots now have three strategies to play: Aggressive, Balanced and Economist. Each bot gets a random strategy at the beginning of the game. They also can learn talents and decide what is the most efficient way to spend their gold.
[*] "Sorcerer's Apprentice" talent has changed. Extra charges now will be collected from taking damage, instead of extra charge from auto-attacks. Also it's allowed now investing only 1 point that will increase the ability charge by 0.5.
[*] Restyled pins for Brawl and Coop rounds.
[*] Friends now can be invited to custom lobbies from different regions.
[/list]

[h2]Changes for Pieces[/h2]
[list]
[*] Base characteristics for Knights have been changed to make them better tankers, while dealing less damage.
[*] The Lucifer Ability has been extended to deal pure damage when the health threshold is not reached. (250|500|750). Also it requires only 4 blocks to charge now (instead of old 5).
[*] Inazuma needs 4 charge blocks for the ability (instead of old 5).
[/list]

[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] The damage recap panel will hide after player dies.
[*] Ranged pieces now generate Miss feedback too when projectile doesn't hit the target.
[*] "Random <PieceType>" talents will no longer create fake pieces for players who will reuse your current arena for fights after.
[*] Explosive mines now will trigger even if they are spawned by a ghost player. Their damage has been improved. Now they inflict 15% of max health instead of old 10%.
[*] Pieces affected by "Lucky Triple" talent will no longer be ignored on the Damage Recap panel.
[*] Remove support for resolutions with aspect ration different from 16:9 and 16:10.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for Release 20201021.2
notes.content:
[h1]Feeling competitive? We just introduced a leaderboard![/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introducing Top 200 Players Leaderboard.
[*] Introducing Russian Localization.
[*] Enabling players joined to a lobby to invite their Steam Friends to join the same lobby (supported only for players in the same region currently).
[*] Enhancing the Coop Round to have the Dragon's power scaling with number of total players alive. Winning the match against the dragon will increase the level of all participating pieces by one. Losing the match will destroy the pieces participated forever.
[*] Changed piece selection mechanics for the brawl and coop rounds. A pin is now shown on top of the selectable pieces. Clicking the pins will select the respective piece.
[*] Improved visuals of arenas, making them more lightweight in the same time.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] If a region is down and user cannot login because of that, a possibility is given to try and connect to a different region.
[/list]

notes.title: Change Notes for release 20201002.5
notes.content:
[h1]We've added a tutorial map, balanced the gameplay and improved our UI design[/h1]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] A tutorial map has been added to highlight the basics of the game.
[*] We now support 3 regions for game hosting: America, Asia-Pacific and Europe.
[*] We've completely redesigned the HUD.
[/list]

[h2]Talent Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Expatriate Talent[/b] applies now two random synergy buffs (one race and one class synergy buff).
[/list]

[h2]Chess Piece Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] All piece stats have been reviewed updated to ensure a balanced gameplay.
[/list]

[h2]New Skins Available[/h2]
[list]
[*] The [b]Stonetablet[/b] theme is now available also for the reroll lever and marketplace lock.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fix pieces received using the [b]Random Piece Talents[/b] being visible on board during the fighting phase. They were also counted to the current synergies and could overwrite pieces the player already owned before.
[*] Explosive mines don't trigger anymore on pieces that will be automatically removes from the board as excess.
[*] Price indicator won't become red if the [b]Credit Line Talent[/b] is learned and a player has sufficient amount of funds.
[*] Fixed problem when round summary screen appeared or when relocated to other arenas while dragging a piece, that piece was not released and would end up in an inconsistent state somewhere on the map.
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha 2.0 is now live
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce to you that the [b]second Alpha session[/b] is open!

[h1]HOW TO PLAY[/h1]

To make the most out of your gameplay experience, we've put together a short [b]Game Info[/b] page in the main menu of the game, containing the most important details explaining the basics.
 
[h1]WHAT TO EXPECT[/h1]

Since the game is still alpha, you may encounter bugs, crashes, lag, imbalance, and longer than normal matchmaking times.
A short note on the customizable items: buying in-game currency [i]Crowns[/i] is free of charge and purchasable once every minute. Customizable items can be purchased using [i]Crowns[/i]. Your inventory will be reset once the BETA version of the game is released.

[h1]JOIN OUR DISCORD CHANNEL[/h1]

We would really appreciate you joining our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wFSfnpM]Discord channel[/url] and share your experiences and impressions with us and with the alpha testing community.

We will be using the same channel to keep you updated with the gameplay changes and news.

[h1]THIS IS A PRIVATE TEST[/h1]

To play, you'll have to agree to a [b]Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)[/b], which means you can't stream, capture video, post screenshots, or share any information with anyone outside our dedicated alpha-test Discord channel. For additional details you can also read our [url=https://www.kotbgame.com/legal/alpha-test-program-participation-agreement/index.html]Alpha Testing Program Participation Terms and Conditions[/url].
We appreciate your time and look forward to hearing your feedback. We promise to listen.


Enjoy the competition and may the best win!

notes.content:
